description: This file defines a trait 'SessionConnectionConfigTrait' used within the AWS SDK for DynamoDB. It encapsulates configuration options for session storage, including table name, hash key, attribute names and types, session lifetime, locking mechanisms, and related settings. The trait provides getter and setter methods for these configuration parameters and an initConfig method for initializing the configuration from an array.

methods.name: initConfig
methods.description: Initializes configuration values from an array, mapping underscored keys to camelCase setter methods, and sets default session lifetime if not provided.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the DynamoDB table used for session storage.

methods.name: setTableName
methods.description: Sets the DynamoDB table name used for session storage.

methods.name: getHashKey
methods.description: Returns the name of the hash key attribute in the table.

methods.name: setHashKey
methods.description: Sets the name of the hash key attribute.

methods.name: getDataAttribute
methods.description: Returns the name of the data attribute used to store session data.

methods.name: setDataAttribute
methods.description: Sets the name of the data attribute.

methods.name: getDataAttributeType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the data attribute.

methods.name: setDataAttributeType
methods.description: Sets the data type of the data attribute.

methods.name: getSessionLifetime
methods.description: Returns the session lifetime (expiration time).

methods.name: setSessionLifetime
methods.description: Sets the session lifetime (expiration time).

methods.name: getSessionLifetimeAttribute
methods.description: Returns the attribute name for session lifetime.

methods.name: setSessionLifetimeAttribute
methods.description: Sets the attribute name for session lifetime.

methods.name: isConsistentRead
methods.description: Returns whether consistent reads are enabled.

methods.name: setConsistentRead
methods.description: Sets whether to use consistent reads.

methods.name: getBatchConfig
methods.description: Returns batch configuration options for garbage collection.

methods.name: setBatchConfig
methods.description: Sets batch configuration options for garbage collection.

methods.name: isLocking
methods.description: Returns whether session locking is enabled.

methods.name: setLocking
methods.description: Enables or disables session locking.

methods.name: getMaxLockWaitTime
methods.description: Returns the max wait time in seconds for lock acquisition.

methods.name: setMaxLockWaitTime
methods.description: Sets the max wait time in seconds for lock acquisition.

methods.name: getMinLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Returns the minimum microseconds to wait between lock retries.

methods.name: setMinLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Sets the minimum microseconds to wait between lock retries.

methods.name: getMaxLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Returns the maximum microseconds to wait between lock retries.

methods.name: setMaxLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Sets the maximum microseconds to wait between lock retries.
